title: The Undertow of the old quarter
author: Coral Reyes
blurb: Coral Ishikawa, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
